background: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of JPMorgan Chase, the largest bank in the United States, serving consumers, businesses, corporates and institutions across the country and worldwide.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at AA-, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024, the strongest ratings of any large US operating bank held here. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 15.0% and leverage of 7.5% both in the top quarter of US banks, though CET1 has fallen 0.5 points since 30 Jun 2025. No liquidity ratios are held here for the bank, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. The benchmark US bank on both ratings and capital.
